Seminar Title:

Redefining Organizational Success: Developing and Validating an Employee Sustainability Framework

Seminar Type:

Speaker Type:

Date and Time:

12 Nov 2026 01:00 PM

Contact:

Manvendra Pratap Singh

Abstract:

In the current competitive environment in emerging nations, employees are seeking meaningful and happy workplaces. However, despite growing organizational social sustainability efforts, deteriorating employees' well-being, rising unhappiness, and resignation rates signify an escalating crisis threatening organizational growth. Despite increased focus on sustainability frameworks, the social dimension, particularly employee sustainability, remains conceptually fragmented, measurement-deficient, and primarily inside-out in orientation, leaving employees' holistic well-being unaddressed. To bridge this gap, the present research develops a comprehensive outside-in employee sustainability scale and a holistic model in the context of the Indian manufacturing sector. It is grounded in the PERMA model, servant leadership theory, Ability-Motivation-Opportunity theory, and Buddhist philosophies of Sutta Piṭaka. The research uses a mixed-methods approach employing bibliometric analysis, various Multi-Criteria Decision-Making techniques, and Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling. The employee sustainability construct is validated as a second-order formative scale. It comprises eight factors, with health and safety, psychological well-being, and egalitarianism being the most vital factors. Findings from holistic model show that employee sustainability significantly associates with employee happiness, organizational attractiveness, and financial performance, with employee happiness and organizational attractiveness complementary partially mediating the employee sustainability&ndashfinancial performance relationship. The study associates the happiness of the employee as the key link between employee sustainability and organizational performance in emerging economies. The findings reveal that employees' sustainability is an important strategic enabler for the success of the organization, bridging Eastern philosophical wisdom with Western corporate frameworks. &nbsp
